player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id} o Negotiation Jɛkulu la.
I be na sɛbɛndɛn, i ka fɔ ko sɛbɛndɛn in kɛlɛbɛcogo bɛɛ o sɛbɛndɛn in bɛɛ kɔnɔnna.
Sɛbɛndɛn i be na, o sɛbɛndɛn in kɛlɛbɛcogo bɛɛ, o ye:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Kɛlɛbɛcogo kɛrɛɛn, i ka kɛ jokelani i ye, i ka kɔlɔsi.
I ka di yan: 
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Donkili ye -> Donkili in bɛ se]
  - '[Accept]': I ka daɲɛ kɔlɔsi in ye.
  - '[Deny]': I ka kɔlɔsi in kɛrɛɛn (kɛrɛnkɛrɛn).
Jɛkulu in bɛɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛn {max_turns} kɛlɛbɛcogo la.

invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Jagokɛla {player_id} ye jago kɛli waleya jira cogo fili la.

outcome.draw: Yɛlɛma kelen bɛ kɛ fɛn marata hakɛ la ɲinan.
